independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the popup and its items (the menu's).
The point anchor and the menu's roles, data-* and navigation.

intent: Offer actions for an area or object at the pointer, on a secondary press

properties.description: Whether the popup is open (reflected). Setting it opens or closes without an openchange event; a submenu closes with its menu.
Open at connect; focus stays where it is (an interaction moves it into the popup).
Preset: the generated area's text when no trigger part is authored.
The area ignores contextmenu, long presses and keys; the native context menu shows instead.
Preferred side of the point: bottom (default) or top; the popup flips when that side has no room.
Alignment at the point: start (default), center or end.
Inherited from ui-menu; does nothing on a context menu (its area has no hover gesture).
The rest before a hover opens a submenu, in ms (inherited from ui-menu).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: contextmenu, a 500 ms touch press, Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key opens the popup (reason trigger-press), or an item press, outside press, Escape or focus leaving closes it; preventDefault keeps it as it is

events.name: change
events.detail: checkbox item: { checked: boolean, reason: 'item-press', event }; radio group: { value: string, reason: 'item-press', event }
events.trigger: a press (or Enter / Space) on a checkbox item toggles its checked attribute (dispatched on the item), or on a radio item sets its radio group's value (dispatched on the group); preventDefault keeps the state

semantics.role: none (the area has no role; the popup is role=menu with menuitem / menuitemcheckbox / menuitemradio items)

keyboard.keys: Shift+F10, ContextMenu on the area or an element in it
keyboard.action: open the popup at the focused element's start corner, on the first item

keyboard.keys: ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home, End, a printable character
keyboard.action: move between items, as in ui-menu

keyboard.keys: ArrowRight (ArrowLeft in RTL) on a submenu trigger; ArrowLeft in a submenu

sources: aria-label on the popup part (the area names nothing)

content.children: A [data-part=trigger] (the area, any content) and a [data-part=popup] with ui-menu's item, checkbox-item, radio-item, group, radio-group and separator parts and nested ui-menu submenus. Preset: the area and the items as children; the popup is generated.

constraints: The area keeps the author's content and size; make it focusable (tabindex) or hold a focusable element so Shift+F10 can reach it.
The popup is placed from script at the pointer (CSS anchor positioning needs an element); it moves when the gesture repeats while open.
Item activation is the item's click; checkbox items and radio groups change as in ui-menu.
Setting open from script opens at the last point (initially the viewport's top left).

avoidWhen.when: The only way to reach an action.
avoidWhen.reason: A secondary press is undiscoverable on many devices; also offer the action in a visible menu or button.

avoidWhen.when: Text the user may want the browser's own context menu for (copy, spellcheck).
avoidWhen.reason: The context menu replaces the native one over its area.

nodes.summary: The area that opens the menu (no role; data-popup-open while open, data-disabled), the author's content as it is. Base UI ContextMenu.Trigger.
